summary: Added `import type { WorkspaceInfo }` from `../../models/workspace/workspace.types.js`.

Defined `resolveWorkspace(res, projectId, workspaceId): WorkspaceInfo | undefined` as a private helper inside `registerWorkspaceRoutes()`. It calls `workspaceManager.getById()`, sends a 404 on undefined/throws, and returns the `WorkspaceInfo` on success.
Refactored 6 handler blocks to use the helper: GET /workspaces/:wid, POST /setup, POST /regenerate-workspace-file, GET /health, POST /launch/vscode, POST /launch/github-desktop/:rid.
GET /workspaces/:wid now uses `resolveWorkspace()` followed by `sendJson(res, 200, withInitialized(workspace))`.

comments.note: In the `launch/github-desktop/:rid` handler (line ~430), `resolveWorkspace()` is called before `projectManager.getById()`. This means a missing workspace returns 404 before a missing project does, which is a minor ordering inconsistency compared to the health and regenerate-workspace-file handlers where project is checked first. Both orderings are valid but inconsistent — future readers may find it surprising. Consider standardising to project-first across all compound-check handlers.
